note: What a person may promise (HEGEL_PROMISES, pc/WORLD-2-WEEK1.md P1), and what in the engine keeps it. A person with no entry under 'people' can promise nothing. 'says': how the promise is named to the voice and in the record's lines. 'minutes': [least, most] until it is kept. 'place': where it is kept. 'kitchen': refused, and broken, while the engine's kitchen is shut (World.kitchen: the wage or the groceries owed), as the engine's own meals and tea are. 'keeps': which engine mechanism keeps it ('tea': the tea event; 'plate': a plate laid at home that he can eat as a laid-out meal). 'kept_by': in words, for the owner. 'event': the line that joins the moment when it is kept. 'by_meal': the line when the engine's own meal (or own tea) is laid out at that very moment and keeps it instead.

tea.kept_by: World.promise_round, in World.situation: the tea event as the engine brings its own (a snack through World.feed, the 'brings tea' entry on the page); gated by World.kitchen like the engine's own tea
tea.event: Ramesh brings the tea he promised.
tea.by_meal: The tea Ramesh brings is the tea he promised.

plate.kept_by: World.promise_round lays the plate (state['today']['laid']); World.plate returns it, so the eat action at home, World.meal_status and Engine.quiet_meal take it as they take Ramesh's plate; eating it is World.feed('meal')
plate.event: Ramesh sets down the plate he promised: {dish}.
plate.by_meal: The {meal} Ramesh has laid out is the plate he promised.
